body.name: Basecamp Cloudbook Pro
body.description: The Basecamp Cloudbook Pro. A dependable laptops pick with a clean, no-nonsense design and the everyday features you actually use.

specs.warranty: 1 year warranty, extendable to 2 on registration
specs.inTheBox: Cloudbook, Recovery key card, Power cord, Microfibre cloth, Warranty card

reviews.author: Lakshmi T.
reviews.title: No complaints at all
reviews.body: Been using this daily for about three months now. It does the one job it advertises and does it well. Second Basecamp product I own and both have lasted. Holding up well so far.

reviews.author: Yusuf D.
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Wanted to like this one. Documentation is thin and the app is worse. Packaging arrived crushed as well. Going with a different brand.

reviews.author: Meera P.
reviews.title: Good, with caveats
reviews.body: It is fine, but I expected slightly more. It works, though the instructions are close to useless. About what I expected at this price. Still, I am keeping it.

reviews.author: Siddharth H.
reviews.title: Good, with caveats
reviews.body: It is fine, but I expected slightly more. Performance is fine, the packaging was a mess. Basecamp have made better, but this is serviceable. Good value, not a standout.
